answer: One California RN license makes each extra identity pay $190 per two-year renewal plus 30 hours of continuing education; a farm running N fakes pays N×$190 and cannot share it because one license names exactly one nurse and cannot be lent or split. The registry checks each number against Nursys, the national vault of license records, where a river of renewals keeps statuses current and each license docks once at the wharf. A farm reusing one license dies by license dedup at 2: the second identity on that number flags both and burns both seats.
